sketches.mechanism: Non-strict evaluation allows a recursively defined bottom value to be passed to a function that never demands it.
sketches.resonance: What would fall forever can remain peacefully present as long as no one asks it to explain itself.
sketches.draft:
secret :: a
secret = secret
kept :: ()
kept = const () secret

sketches.mechanism: ARC zeroing weak references do not retain their object and are automatically set to nil when the last strong reference disappears.
sketches.resonance: A hand that refuses to possess is the first to become empty.

sketches.mechanism: An empty inductive type can be eliminated into any proposition because there is no constructor case to handle.
sketches.resonance: From an absence that can never arrive, every impossible answer is valid.
sketches.draft:
Inductive Absence : Prop := .
Definition anything (a : Absence) : forall P : Prop, P :=
  match a with end.
